plan.scope: Independent exploratory extension; existing A/B/C/D results and controller unchanged
plan.data_source: All macro-action transition labels originate from PyBullet simulation, not human videos
plan.offset_recipe: First action zero offset; next four independent uniform XY offsets from [-0.03,0.03] m; Generator(SeedSequence([91371, scene_seed]))
plan.state: Initial object XY in meters; privileged during collection, external estimate at deployment
plan.action: Absolute grasp XY command recorded before execution; place target and skill parameters fixed
targets: final object XY displacement in meters

model.output: 2 displacement values scaled by 0.15 m and 2 binary logits

training.classification_loss: mean BCE of lift and success
training.checkpoint: fixed final step; no model selection

baselines: training empirical lift and success priors
evaluation.ensemble: mean displacements and mean sigmoid probabilities
evaluation.intervals: No iid episode confidence interval because five actions share each scene

integration_demo.model: equal-weight ensemble of all three final world models
integration_demo.purpose: Outcome prediction diagnostic; no new planner or altered primary evaluation

source: simulator state/action/outcomes only; no phone-video physics labels
